title: Multi-tenant Banking & UINSta
summary: At Innovanitics I built onboarding features for UBA's UINSta app and helped design a multi-tenant banking platform that serves several financial institutions from one codebase.

caseStudy.overview: Two strands of enterprise banking work at Innovanitics: features for an existing bank's consumer app, and a platform meant to be configured for many banks.
caseStudy.problem: Banks wanted their own branded apps without each one becoming a separate codebase to build and maintain.
contribution: Implemented account creation, onboarding and setup features in UINSta (UBA's mobile app).
Designed and implemented the tenant architecture for a banking solution serving multiple financial institutions.
Built bank-specific proof-of-concept apps to show prospective clients the platform and speed up adoption.
Found and fixed deployment bugs to keep releases stable.
constraints: Client confidentiality — no screenshots, code or client data can be shared.
caseStudy.approach: A single platform built to serve multiple financial institutions through a tenant architecture, with bank-specific proof-of-concept apps used to demonstrate it to prospective clients.
